{"code": "import numpy as np

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm since we need it for mean calculation
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the mean flipper length for each species to capture exact values
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.loc[mean_flipper_by_species['flipper_length_mm'].idxmax()]['species']

# Print the species with the highest mean
print(highest_mean_species)"}
